name: Alora Alenius
source:
A wildly successful Biochemist considering her young age, She's a result of the 'wonder child' project and overall regarded as a genius finishing her biochemistry degree by 17 and currentIy in the process of doing her doctorate while maintaining a government internship. Little is known about Alora outside of her academic achievements and she seems to want to keep it that way.

She's a fairly reserved, albeit pretty judgemental woman. She's far more mature compared to other prisoners her age but has taken the charge in collaborating with them for the sake of attempting to find an escape ... Even if they test her patience.

She's seemingly completely apathetic about her crime. When interrogated she seemed more focused on if her earpiece still operating than atonement. Freak.

[From the [url=https://danganronpa-fanganprojects.fandom.com/wiki/Alora_Alenius]Wiki[/url]]
